lane:
تَيَّارٌ : see art. تير.

تَيَّارٌ _Waves:_ (S, M, A, Msb:) or _waves of the sea,_ or _of a great river,_ (M, IAth, K,) _having a current;_ (K,* TA;) and _its main body,_ or _deep:_ (IAth, TA:) [in the present day, the _current,_ or _main current, of a sea_ or _great river:_] or _vehemence of flow_ or _current:_ (Msb:) accord. to some, of the measure فَعَّالٌ, from تير; (Msb;) i. c., from تِيرٌ signifying “ vanity ” and “ pride: ” (TA:) accord. to others, of the measure فَيْعَالٌ, (Msb, TA,) from تَارَ, aor. يَتُورُ, though this verb is obsolete, (TA,) originally تَيْوَارٌ, the و being changed into ى and then incorporated into the preceding ى. (Msb.) === Applied to a man, ‡ _Vain,_ or _having a fond opinion of himself,_ (A, K,) and _proud;_ (K;) _who swells up like waves, in his vanity._ (A.) === ‡ A horse _that rises like waves in his running.._ (A.) === ‡ A vein _that runs,_ or _flows, quickly,_ when cut. (S, A, K.)

entries.text: التيار، مشددة: موج البحر الذي ينضح، والتائه المتكبر. وقطع عرقا تيارا، أي: سريع الجرية. والتير، بالكسر: التيه، والحائز بين الحائطين. ونهر تيرى، كضيزى: بالأهواز. وحميد بن تير الطويل: محدث، مات وهو قائم يصلي. وعمرو بن تيري، كسيري أمرا من سار: شيخ لابن المبارك.
